def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    rows = len(state)
    cols = len(state[0])
    next_state = [[0]*cols for _ in range(rows)]
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            # Compute coord-class
            coord_class = (r + c) % 3
            
            # Get neighbors based on coord-class (toroidal wrapping)
            neighbors = []
            if coord_class == 0:
                # Diagonal tetrad: NE, NW, SE, SW
                neighbors.append(state[(r-1)%rows][(c+1)%cols])  # NE
                neighbors.append(state[(r-1)%rows][(c-1)%cols])  # NW
                neighbors.append(state[(r+1)%rows][(c+1)%cols])  # SE
                neighbors.append(state[(r+1)%rows][(c-1)%cols])  # SW
            elif coord_class == 1:
                # von Neumann: N, S, E, W
                neighbors.append(state[(r-1)%rows][c])  # N
                neighbors.append(state[(r+1)%rows][c])  # S
                neighbors.append(state[r][(c+1)%cols])  # E
                neighbors.append(state[r][(c-1)%cols])  # W
            else:
                # class 2: axial-2: cells at distance 2 along N,S,E,W
                neighbors.append(state[(r-2)%rows][c])  # N
                neighbors.append(state[(r+2)%rows][c])  # S
                neighbors.append(state[r][(c+2)%cols])  # E
                neighbors.append(state[r][(c-2)%cols])  # W
            
            # Compute next state: (sum of neighbors + 2) mod 3
            neighbor_sum = sum(neighbors)
            next_state[r][c] = (neighbor_sum + 2) % 3
    
    return next_state
